Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for EcoShift, a stylized Roblox survival adventure.
Create a square transparent PNG, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows of evenly spaced inventory objects. Sixteen invisible equal cells in row-major order. Each object centered in its cell, occupies 70-76% of the cell, generous fully transparent gutters. Entire object visible. No drawn grid, frames, panels, borders, labels, numbers, logos, scenery, floor, or cast shadow.
ART DIRECTION: appealing premium ROBLOX game item icons, clean stylized low-poly 3D object renders. CHUNKY SIMPLE MESHES with softly beveled edges, broad flat-color facets, smooth matte toy-like materials, restrained gentle ambient occlusion. Only 2-4 large material/color regions per object. Warm neutral key light from upper left. Strong saturated-but-natural colors, uncluttered silhouette instantly recognizable at 48 pixels. Actual physical objects that could be built faithfully as simple Roblox meshes. NO photorealistic textures, NO photographic food, NO realistic woodgrain, NO tiny scratches, NO detailed fur strands, NO gritty brushwork, NO cinematic lighting, NO heavy outlines or flat line-art. Crystal glow only a small clean luminous accent. Fur is a few large sculpted tufts. Timber is simple warm brown with 2-3 broad grooves. Metal is smooth gray with wide bright bevels. Consistent three-quarter view. Equipment is diagonal and fully contained. Armor is an empty garment with NO mannequin or person; boots shown as pair.
